# OA Group Nigeria

## Website purpose
Institutional platform for OA Group Nigeria, a diversified Nigerian business group.

## Master proposition
A diversified Nigerian business group delivering professional, financial, property, advisory and commercial solutions through a portfolio of specialist companies.

## Operating companies
- Olusola Adekanola & Co — Professional & Assurance Services — https://olusola-adekanola.oagroupng.com
- OA Consulting Limited — Consulting & Advisory — https://oaconsulting.oagroupng.com
- Henrisol Properties Ltd — Real Estate & Property — https://henrisol.oagroupng.com
- Maria Oyinlola Limited — Financial Services — https://mol.oagroupng.com
- Pearl Primus Multipurpose Contracting Limited — Contracting & Commercial Ventures — https://pearlprimus.oagroupng.com

## Primary audiences
Corporate and SMEs, government and public institutions, financial services organisations, property investors, project and infrastructure stakeholders, professional-service clients, institutions and private clients.
